company.name: Epsilon3
company.shortDescription: Epsilon3 is the OS for spacecraft and complex operations.
company.description: Epsilon3 is building the future of spacecraft and complex operations software. Epsilon3 is committed to modernizing space missions and complex engineering and testing by building the industry standard of operational software. Epsilon3 gives operators the best possible tools throughout an entire project’s lifecycle, which results in 10X more efficiency and operator-friendliness.
